summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting the Board of Directors' acceptance of the resignation of Class D Alternate Director Carla Antonela Matarese for strictly personal reasons, effective June 4, 2026. No price, premium, or stake is involved. The filing is a routine director departure notification to Argentine regulators (CNV, ByMA, A3 Mercados) mapped to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. No advisors, recommendations, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an abrupt board-level departure, though it is for personal reasons and not forced; watch for any subsequent board composition shifts but no risk-arb angle.
